mechanism.claim: In a high-volatility state, the full range of the particular five-minute candle that established the trailing six-hour high measures whether price discovery at the peak was forceful or fragile. An upper-tail peak-candle range relays long, while a lower-tail range relays short for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: upper calibrated peak-candle-range tail long; lower tail short
mechanism.why_distinct: HVPHR attributes the rolling high to one causal candle and uses that candle's full range relative to current close. It is not a Donchian reclaim, current wick, range position, realized-variance allocation, model output, flow, OI, funding, calendar, terminal candidate repair, or diagnostic-control promotion.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: tail onsets depend on the identity and geometry of an endogenous peak-setting candle

causal_features.lookback: 72 completed five-minute bars including the decision bar
causal_features.peak_row: last row attaining the maximum high in the lookback; deterministic last occurrence tie break
causal_features.range_vol: (maximum high-minimum low)/midpoint over 144 completed five-minute bars including the decision bar
causal_features.calibration: 2023H1 source-only q15/q85 of peak_candle_range and q60 of range_vol across complete hourly anchors; no calibration labels or post-entry prices
causal_features.eligibility: range_vol>=q60 and peak_candle_range<=q15 or >=q85; first row of a consecutive same-tail run only
causal_features.missing: inactive; no interpolation or forward fill

oos_clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: freeze singleton and calibration contract, then open source incidence, Gross9 novelty, and stage outcomes sequentially; terminal first failure without tail, tie-break, side, volatility, or hold repair
